name: MingCute Icons
summary: Icon library with 1,663 icons in regular and filled styles, packaged for React, Vue, Svelte, SolidJS and more.
description: MingCute is the public, open-source distribution of the Mingcute Icon System: 1,663 icons on a 24x24 grid, each in Core Regular (2 px stroke) and Core Filled, for 3,326 styled definitions. Ten npm packages ship the same canonical artwork for React, Vue, React Native, Svelte, SolidJS, vanilla JavaScript, web components, standalone SVG and WOFF2 icon fonts. A paid Mingcute Pro tier adds 12 Core, Cute and Sharp style combinations.
contains: 1,663 icons in Core Regular and Core Filled: 3,326 styled definitions
10 npm packages: React, Vue, React Native, Svelte, SolidJS, vanilla JS, web components, SVG, fonts, definitions
24x24 grid; Core Regular uses a consistent 2 px stroke
tree-shakeable ESM packages with typed components
SVG gradients, masks and clipping paths preserved; WOFF2 icon fonts
Figma plugin, MCP server, and website search with SVG/PNG downloads
Mingcute Pro: 12 Core, Cute and Sharp styles, 20,152 definitions, private registry
